bands.0: more than half incomplete or wrong
bands.2: all but four or five (B1 erfüllt)
bands.3: all but two or three (B1 gut erfüllt)

dimensions.label: Aufgabenbewältigung
dimensions.covers: Whether each required piece of information is conveyed unambiguously, in accepted clinical phrasing

dimensions.label: Kommunikative Gestaltung
dimensions.covers: Formal register appropriate to the clinical context; connectives building a coherent whole

dimensions.label: Korrektheit
dimensions.covers: Grammar, spelling, punctuation — at B2, slips are tolerated if they cause no misunderstanding

dimensions.label: Wortschatz
dimensions.covers: Differentiated vocabulary; accuracy across general, occupational and specialist clinical terms
